simple.meaning: גְּדָבָר (gᵉdâbâr) is a Hebrew word meaning “a treasurer.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: גְּדָבָר (H1411) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 3:2, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גְּדָבָר (H1411) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in גְּדָבָר (H1411) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: גְּדָבָר (gᵉdâbâr) / H1411 is traced through Daniel 3:2, Daniel 3:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
